svg.text: GOOGLE CLOUD TPU (v5p / v6e TRILLIUM / TPU7x IRONWOOD / 8t & 8i) VS. NVIDIA GPU (H200 / B200 / GB200)
TPU7x Ironwood (3D Torus ICI + OCS + SparseCore) & v6e/8i Hit 58.4% MFU & -41.4% TCO
2,048-Chip Cluster: Tier 1 Dynamic-Shape PyTorch on TPU (14.2% MFU) vs. Tier 2 H200 ($3.62M/mo) vs. Tier 4 ($2.12M/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–2 Traps: XLA Recompiles & Non-Wrap Torus
1. Dynamic-Shape PyTorch Lift-and-Shift on TPU (14.2% MFU):
• Unbucketed sequence lengths & Python control flow trigger 45s XLA
graph recompilations; custom CUDA C++ kernels fall back to CPU
2. Requesting Non-Wrap 3D Mesh Instead of `4x4x4` Twisted Torus:
• Wrap-around links ONLY activate on dimensions divisible by 4 (`4x4x4`,
`4x4x8`); partial cubes lose 50% bisection bandwidth on All-Reduce
3. 8-GPU NVLink Wall on Multi-Node Clos Fabrics ($3.62M/mo):
• Stepping outside 8-GPU HGX drops bandwidth from 900 GB/s to 50 GB/s
Production Failure Impact (2,048-Chip Cluster Scale):
• Unbucketed XLA MFU: 14.2% (Tier 1) | H200 Clos MFU: 44.5%
• Serving Token Cost: $1.48/1M (Tier 1) | $0.62/1M (Tier 2 H200)
• Monthly 2,048-Chip Cluster TCO: $4.85M (Tier 1) / $3.62M (Tier 2)
🏆 Tier 4: TPU7x Ironwood / 8t & 8i + OCS + Shardy
1. TPU7x Ironwood (4,614 TF FP8, 192GB HBM3e @ 7.37 TB/s, 9,216 Chips):
• `4x4x4` 64-chip Twisted Torus cubes wired via Palomar 3D MEMS OCS;
• Dual-chiplet `2 TensorCores + 4 SparseCores` offloads MoE routing &
embeddings; 8th-gen splits `TPU 8t` (Training) & `TPU 8i` (Inference)
2. 3D Torus Wrap-Around + Optical Circuit Switch (99.2% Goodput):
ICI Resiliency routes around optical faults; Multislice scales DCN
3. JAX/XLA `Shardy` + `MaxText` & Bucketed `vLLM-TPU` ($0.24/1M):
• Pins TP/FSDP on ICI and DP on DCN; keeps CUDA-custom jobs on GB200
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Sustained Cluster MFU: 58.4% | 9,216-Chip OCS Goodput: 99.2%
• Serving Token Cost (v6e/TPU7x/8i): $0.24 / 1M Tokens (-61.3%)
• Monthly 2,048-Chip TCO: $2.12M / mo (-41.4% vs. Tier 2 H200)
